scope.summary: Two small UX polish items the design team asked for before the next release — they don't touch the same code paths so either can ship first.

proposedTasks.title: Tighten spacing on the agent card grid
acceptanceCriteria: Card gap reduces from 24px to 16px on desktop

proposedTasks.title: Replace placeholder avatars with initials chips on the Discussions list
acceptanceCriteria: Initials chip shows first letter of agent name
Background color is deterministic per agent (hash of agent ID)
